regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative market: only Coal and Banks clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate (2 of 22 themes), with Coal barely leading Banks (margin 0.037). The gate has no validated drawdown edge on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the track record's near-coin-flip hit rate (0.537) with weak directional accuracy (0.347) argues for low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Coal's 0.037 margin over Banks widens or flips, and whether the one_narrative structure persists with only two eligible themes. A confirmed handoff would require Banks to overtake Coal in score AND Coal to lose eligibility (fail the trend gate) — not just a crowding flag.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme that is not crowded (crowding_z 0.58) and holds the top rank, giving it the cleanest trend-gate pass on a relative basis. However, its durability bar is only 0.5 (borderline), breadth is just 0.5 (not a broad move), and the hurst_tag is mean-revert — consistent with this market's documented gate whipsaw problem. The lean is a modest directional preference over other eligible themes, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Coal's mean-revert hurst tag plus a 0.5 durability bar means this leadership may already be fading; the one-narrative structure with only two eligible themes suggests rotation risk is high if Banks takes over.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) underperforms Banks (512800.SS) by more than 2% over the next 10 days while both remain eligible.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible, trend-tagged, and have strong breadth (0.944) — the most durable-looking leg in the detector. But they are crowded (crowding_z 1.83, crowded=true), which per guardrails is a sizing-down caution, not a fade or sell. With only a 0.037 margin separating them from Coal and no validated handoff signal, there is no confirmed rotation to act on. An underweight/avoid expresses the crowding caution without predicting a fade.
theses.dissent: Banks have the highest durability bar (0.82) and near-perfect breadth — if any theme can sustain a grind in this mean-reverting tape, it is this one, and avoiding it may leave the trade with no exposure to the strongest trend structure.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) hold their leadership and crowding eases below z=1.0 without a drawdown over the next 10 days (i.e. the crowding flag resolves as a non-event).

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
